title: Nectar & Nymphs (E-commerce App)
description: Developed a full-stack e-commerce platform using MongoDB, Express, Vue, and Node. Implemented JWT authentication, role-based access control, product management, and checkout workflows. Integrated a 24-endpoint RESTful API using Axios, Pinia, Vue Router, and Bootstrap to deliver a responsive 9-page application.

title: API Testing Project
description: A hands-on API testing project focused on validating a MongoDB-backed Express.js REST API. Developed and refactored a 40-test integration suite using Mocha, Chai, and chai-http, covering user authentication, authorization, products, carts, and orders through positive and negative test scenarios.

title: Adventurer's Codex (Blog App)
description: Built a full-stack blog application using Vue.js, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB. Developed authentication and authorization features using JWT and role-based access control, implemented post and comment management, and integrated a 16-endpoint RESTful API. Deployed the application using Vercel and Render while applying form validation and responsive UI design with Bootstrap.

title: Movie Catalog App
description: Built a full-stack movie catalog application using Vue.js, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB. Developed secure authentication and authorization features, movie browsing and management functionality, comment systems, and a 9-endpoint RESTful API. Deployed the frontend and backend using Vercel and Render.

title: Flight606 (Airline Booking System)
description: Collaborated in the design and development of an airline booking system through multiple project phases. Contributed to UI development, Figma prototyping, repository management, testing, debugging, and deployment. Built responsive interfaces using HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, Vue.js, JavaScript, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB while supporting frontend and backend integration. The project remains under active development.
